about.title: About
about.body: PokeFocus turns your study hours into a Pokémon team that studies with you. This is a local prototype: your data lives only in this browser.
about.credits: Sprites from PokeAPI and Pokémon Showdown. Data from PokeAPI. Music and effects are synthesized in your browser.

team.title: Your team studies with you
team.body: While you study, each Pokémon acts on its own and earns points, EXP and catch energy. The bar is its Energy for the day; it refills at 5:00.

start.title: Start with 25 minutes
start.body: Every 25-minute block brings a wave of wild Pokémon at the end. You can pause, but the team is locked until you finish.

conditions.title: Type conditions
conditions.body: Each type does better in certain situations: the time, the weather or the length. They only add, never subtract. Build your team around how and when you study.

weather.title: Weather where you study
weather.body: For now you pick it yourself. Rain boosts Water types, sun boosts Fire and cold boosts Ice.

league.title: This week's league
league.body: Your team's points move you up, and a higher league brings bigger waves. Every Monday everyone goes back to Base League.

energy.title: Energy
energy.body: Every action costs Energy, so fast Pokémon tire sooner. An exhausted Pokémon stops acting but still earns EXP. In the Box they recover 10% per hour.

duration.title: Duration
duration.body: Pick 25, 50, 75 or 100 min, or any length from 15 to 120. Every full 25 minutes adds a wave, and long sessions attract rarer Pokémon.

break.title: Resting counts too
break.body: A complete break gives Energy back to your whole team. If you cut it short, it doesn't count.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.body: Six steps to learn PokeFocus. Close it whenever you like; you can bring it back in Settings.

window.title: Claim in time
window.body: You have 5 minutes to claim 100%. If you're late you get half, so leaving the timer running on its own doesn't pay off.

why.title: Where your points come from
why.body: Each action gives points from the Pokémon's Output, multiplied by its type condition, its Bond and your Focus. Hover each tag for the details.

levelUp.title: Level up!
levelUp.body: Leveling up improves its stats and can teach it techniques. At levels 15, 30 and 50 it gains a technique slot.

hp.title: HP after the damage
hp.body: Your team already weakened these Pokémon with the energy it made while you studied. Less HP means an easier catch. It never drops below 5%.

studyBall.title: Study Ball
studyBall.body: Each wave brings one that always catches a base-form Pokémon at level {{level}} or lower (the limit rises with your trainer level). It only works in this wave: move on without using it and it's lost.

throw.title: Throw a Ball
throw.body: Pick a wild Pokémon and a Ball; you'll see the chance before throwing. If it fails, the Pokémon counterattacks your leader and drains its Energy.

flee.title: Tries before it flees
flee.body: These squares are the misses it has left. When they run out, it flees. Legendaries that flee may come back in your next sessions.

counter.title: Counterattack
counter.body: {{name}} lost {{damage}} Energy. Counterattacks hit the leader first and, if it's exhausted, the next one. A leader with high Grit takes them better.

fled.title: It got away
fled.body: It used all its tries. That's fine: every session brings new waves. Lower HP or putting it to sleep helps next time.

firstCatch.title: Your first catch!
firstCatch.body: It's in your Box now. Between sessions you can add it to your team: up to 6 Pokémon study with you.

charges.title: Technique charges
charges.body: Your team's techniques left effects to use here. Putting a Pokémon to sleep or paralyzing it makes the catch easier; swapping replaces it with another.

shiny.title: Shiny
shiny.body: Shiny Pokémon are very rare. With the right Ball, or a better one, the catch is guaranteed.

next.title: Next wave
next.body: Wild Pokémon you don't catch stay behind. Each wave brings its own Study Ball.

iv.title: You can see quality
iv.body: A technique in your team reveals the quality (IVs) of wild Pokémon. Go for the ones with more stars.

intro.title: Your Box
intro.body: Every Pokémon you catch lives here. Tap one to open its page: techniques, candies, evolution and whether it joins the team.

filters.title: Filter and sort
filters.body: Search by name, filter by type or role, and sort by level or quality (IVs) to find your best candidate.

candies.title: Candies and Dust
candies.body: Candies give EXP to a Pokémon of their line (or type). Each one costs Study Dust, which you only earn by studying: studying stays in charge.

techniques.title: Technique slots
techniques.body: It has 1 to 4 slots depending on its level. Equip a damage technique to weaken wild Pokémon, or a passive or activable one to boost the session.

candies.title: Level it up with candies
candies.body: Each candy gives EXP right away and costs Dust. They go a long way at low levels, great for catching up a new Pokémon.

actions.title: Team, leader or release
actions.body: From here you add it to the team or make it the leader. Releasing duplicates gives you candies of their line.

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.body: Each technique earns stars with the hours it spends equipped in sessions: 5 h, 15 h, 40 h and 100 h. More stars, higher chance to trigger. Remove it and it keeps its Mastery.

extraMoves.title: Extra techniques
extraMoves.body: Each individual has 2 or 3 random extra techniques. The strongest unlock at a higher level; until then they wait here.

iv.title: Quality (IVs)
iv.body: Each individual is born with hidden values from 0 to 31 for each stat. Higher quality means better stats, especially at high levels. No two Bulbasaur are the same.

stats.title: PokeFocus stats
stats.body: Each stat does something in your session: Pace is how often it acts, Output how many points it gives, Catch how much it weakens wild Pokémon. Hover each name to see it.

levelCap.title: Level cap
levelCap.body: Your Pokémon can't go past the current cap. Catch different species to raise it: 25 species open Lv 40 and 45 open Lv 50. Extra EXP isn't lost.

evolve.title: It can evolve!
evolve.body: Evolving improves its stats and keeps its level, techniques and Mastery. Press Evolve whenever you're ready.

energy.title: Daily Energy
energy.body: It's spent by acting and refills at 05:00. In the Box it recovers 10% per hour; in the team, only with breaks, techniques or potions.

bond.title: Bond
bond.body: Grows with every minute it studies in your team, up to +20% points. Some species evolve with high Bond.

intro.title: Build your team
intro.body: Order your 6 with the arrows or add them from the Box. Mix roles: someone for points, someone for catching and someone who can take hits.

leader.title: Pick the leader well
leader.body: It takes the counterattacks when a Ball fails. A leader with lots of Grit and Energy holds up better; check its type weaknesses too.

order.title: Order matters
order.body: The first one is the leader. If it's exhausted, counterattacks go to the next. The rest of the order doesn't change points.

tired.title: Someone is tired
tired.body: An exhausted or sleeping Pokémon doesn't act in the session. Move it to the Box to recover Energy and add someone else.

intro.title: Your Pokédex
intro.body: It records the 56 species of the pack. Those you see in a wave stay as a silhouette; those you catch, in color.

cap.title: More species, higher levels
cap.body: Every different species you catch brings your whole team closer to the next level cap.

intro.title: This week's league
intro.body: Your team's points raise your league, and each league lets more wild Pokémon appear per wave. Every Monday everyone goes back to Base.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.body: Hover each bar or point for details. The history below has every number.

focus.title: Focus
focus.body: It measures how much you really studied (in the prototype the dev panel simulates it). It multiplies points, EXP and Dust, and each Pokémon's Grit softens drops.

why.title: A real break
why.body: While it runs, step away from the screen. When it ends, collect the Energy for your team.

audio.title: Your sound
audio.body: Set music and effects separately. You can keep music only during sessions, or mute it altogether.

intro.title: Missions
intro.body: There are 3 daily and 3 weekly missions that renew by themselves, plus milestones for registering species. They advance as you study and catch; claim them here.

ready.title: Mission complete!
ready.body: You have rewards waiting. Open Missions to claim them.

pokedex.title: Pokédex milestones
pokedex.body: They complete once, when you catch 10, 25 and 50 different species. They give evolution stones and other items.

bag.title: Bag
bag.noCandies: None yet. Catching gives 3 of that line and releasing gives 1 to 3.
bag.noItems: No items yet. Potions and stones will come with missions.
bag.healHow: Use it from a Pokémon's page

emptyMore.title: Your catches will land here
emptyMore.body: Finish a session and throw Balls in the wave. Every Pokémon you catch shows up in the Box.

noMatch.title: No Pokémon match
noMatch.body: Try another name, type or role, or clear the filters to see the whole Box.

gone.title: This Pokémon is gone
gone.body: Maybe you released it or it evolved in another tab. Go back to the Box to see the others.

detail.releaseTip_other: It goes back to the wild and gives you {{count}} candies of its line.

detail.noAbility: Its species has no abilities in PokeFocus yet.

tech.damageDesc: Every action makes {{type}} catch Energy to weaken wild Pokémon.
tech.masteryBody: Equipped for {{hours}} h of sessions. Multiplies its chance ×{{mult}}.

candy.reachSame: Gets it closer to the next level.
candy.noneOfThese: You have none of these. Catch or release Pokémon of this line.

energy.title: Energy and Bond
energy.teamRegen: In the team it doesn't recover by itself: it refills at 05:00 or with a break.
energy.boxRegen: In the Box it recovers {{pct}} per hour.
energy.asleep: Asleep from Rest: it won't act next session.
energy.noHeal: You have no potions. They will come with missions.

bond.title: Bond
bond.note: Grows with every minute in the team, up to +{{max}} points.

dex.capTop: Your Pokémon can reach Lv {{cap}}, the highest in this pack.
dex.unknownBody: You haven't seen it yet. It will show up in some wave: types with an active condition and your team's types appear more often.
dex.caughtNone: Caught before; you have none now.
dex.seenOnly: Seen in a wave, not caught yet.

break.offerBody: Get up, drink some water and stretch. If you finish the break, your team recovers {{pct}} of its Energy.
break.body: Step away from the screen for a moment. Your team is resting too.
break.doneBody: Well done! Collect your team's Energy and come back whenever you like.
break.earlyNote: If you end it early, your team doesn't recover Energy.

catch.title: Catch your first Pokémon
catch.how: After a session, use the Study Ball in the wave.

team.title: Add a second team member
team.how: In Team, pick someone from your Box.

equip.title: Equip a technique
equip.how: Open a Pokémon's page and equip a technique in a slot.

candy.title: Use a candy
candy.how: On its page, use candies and Dust to level it up.

evolve.title: Evolve a Pokémon
evolve.how: When it reaches its level, press Evolve on its page.

missions.title: Missions
missions.subtitle: Small study and catch goals. Each one gives Balls, Dust, potions or other items when you claim it.
